definition_en: The ability to perform physical tasks requiring fine motor control, sustained physical effort, and accurate hand-eye coordination.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk melakukan tugasan fizikal yang memerlukan kawalan motor halus, tenaga berterusan, dan koordinasi mata-tangan yang tepat.
typical_tasks_en:
• Assemble delicate jewellery pieces using small tools for eight hours.
• Sew intricate embroidery patterns on traditional garments.
• Perform repetitive quality checks on assembled circuit boards for a full shift.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Pasang barang kemas halus menggunakan alatan kecil selama lapan jam.
• Jahit corak sulaman rumit pada pakaian tradisional.
• Lakukan pemeriksaan kualiti berulang pada papan litar terpasang sepanjang syif.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires fine motor skills or hand-eye coordination
• The task involves sustained physical effort or stamina
• The task requires precise physical manipulation of tools or materials
• The task involves physical assembly, crafting, or repair work
• The task requires maintaining physical accuracy over repetitive actions
exclusion_rules:
• The task is entirely mental or digital with no physical component
• The user operates machines that perform the physical work
• The task requires only gross motor movement without precision
• The user is supervising physical work without doing it
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task is digital, machine-operated, or only gross motor movement.

confusions.boundary_rule: Manual dexterity is physical execution. Sensory-processing is perception.
confusions.example_task: Thread a needle and sew a fine seam while feeling the fabric tension.
confusions.expected_labels: Manual dexterity, endurance and precision; Sensory-processing abilities

confusions.boundary_rule: Manual dexterity may be used in inspection, but quality control is about standards.
confusions.example_task: Use steady hands to check delicate components for defects.
confusions.expected_labels: Quality control; Manual dexterity, endurance and precision

confusions.boundary_rule: Manual dexterity is physical. Dependability is a behavioural trait.
confusions.example_task: Assemble products accurately for a full shift.
confusions.expected_labels: Manual dexterity, endurance and precision; Dependability and attention to detail
